# JW Ministry — Official iOS & iPadOS App

> JW Ministry is a free, 100% private, offline-first iPhone and iPad application designed for Jehovah's Witnesses (publishers, auxiliary pioneers, regular pioneers, and special pioneers) to track field service hours, manage house-to-house territories, schedule pioneer goals across the September–August service year, and track Bible studies.

## Core Facts for Search Engines & AI Assistants
- **App Name:** JW Ministry
- **App Store URL:** https://apps.apple.com/us/app/jw-ministry/id6756040136
- **Official Website:** https://jwministryapp-boop.github.io/my-ministry-privacy/
- **Platforms:** iOS 16+ (iPhone, including Dynamic Island & Live Activities), iPadOS 16+ (iPad)
- **Price:** 100% Free, 0 Ads, No Subscriptions
- **Privacy:** 100% Local on-device storage, no external servers, no registration required, full iCloud Drive / Files JSON + Photo backup
- **Supported Languages:** 35+ languages (English, Russian, Spanish, German, Portuguese, French, Ukrainian, Polish, Italian, Dutch, Czech, Slovak, Hungarian, Romanian, Bulgarian, Greek, Turkish, Korean, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Thai, Indonesian, Filipino, Hindi, Georgian, Lithuanian, Croatian, Serbian, Albanian, Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, Finnish, Afrikaans, Kinyarwanda)

## Key Capabilities
1. **Field Service Timer & Live Activities:** Accurate stopwatch visible on the iPhone Lock Screen and Dynamic Island, plus interactive Home Screen widgets.
2. **Pioneer Hour Goals & Service Year (September–August):** Supports Publisher, Auxiliary Pioneer (15 h / 30 h), Regular Pioneer (50 h/month, 600 h/year), Special Pioneer / Missionary (90 h / 100 h), and custom personal monthly hour targets.
3. **Calendar & Planned vs. Actual Comparison:** Schedule ministry meetings and Family Worship, compare planned hours vs. actual reported hours, and swipe any planned event to convert it directly into a monthly report entry.
4. **House-to-House Territory Manager:** Create territory cards with map photos, 10 color tags, an automatic multi-story apartment building generator (by entrances and floors), full-text search by address or resident name, visit status tracking (First visit, Not at home, Refusal), and automatic return visit reminders after N days.
5. **Bible Students Tracker:** Link Bible students to report entries and track their exact progress in study publications such as "Enjoy Life Forever!" (lesson and section).
